followUps: Persist events in an append-only database table.
Add event type validation and artifact references.
Add per-tenant retention and redaction policies.
followUpGuide: For persistence, use `(run_id, seq)` indexes and append-only writes.
For artifacts, store lightweight references in events and keep blobs in object storage.
For enterprise retention, redact sensitive values before cross-boundary replication.
complexityAnalysis: - Append. Time: O(message length) for redaction. Space: O(1) plus stored event.
- Listing scans stored events in this simple version. Time: O(n). Space: O(limit).
- Indexed follow-up uses `(run_id, seq)` for O(log n + limit) reads.
solutionGuide: Store each event with run ID and the instance-wide sequence. Redact the specified token pattern before storing, then filter by run and cursor. Build new output dictionaries so returned records can't mutate the log. The pattern doesn't detect every secret format.
